People: Lewis Carroll (author, Wikidata Q38082), died 1898; Harry Furniss (illustrator, Wikidata Q5668975), died 1925. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Carroll, Lewis, 1832-1898; Furniss, Harry, 1854-1925 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Sylvie and Bruno, Macmillan and Co. (London), 1889, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/india.history.resource.87330. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 87%, 90%, 95% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Lewis Carroll, Harry Furniss, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
